description: SP ENW - Operational Data - National Energy Outage (NEO) Data is a dataset listed in Electricity North West open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Electricity North West. Dataset Classification - Shared SP ENW - National Energy Outage (NEO) Data Developed through a joint, co-ordinated initiative by all UK networks, our National Energy Outage (NEO) Data has been created with interoperability in mind, allowing stakeholders to access data in a common format from all networks Updated every 15 minutes, this mapped dataset indicates ... Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Operational Data. Its keywords are NEOP, National Energy Outage Platform, Live, Incidents, NEO. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is SP ENW Shared Licence (https://electricitynorthwest.opendatasoft.com/explore/dataset/enwl-shared-data-licence/table/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-enw-open-data-portal.
